data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Hephzibah means 'My delight is in you'. This name is mentioned in the Bible, in the book of Isaiah, as a new name for Jerusalem, representing God's love and affection for his people. The name Hephzibah carries the meaning “My delight is in you” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek.
